content: GDPR DSAR export best practice: machine-readable structured format (JSON preferred technically; CSV acceptable; PDF summary for non-technical requestors), UTF-8, data dictionary/column metadata, avoid proprietary formats. Deliver via secure authenticated portal/download rather than raw email attachment. Verify requestor identity before fulfilling. For multi-tenant/multi-workspace products, scope the export explicitly to avoid over- or under-disclosure. Self-service portal with API-driven extraction reduces manual support load and helps meet 30-day regulatory window.
